mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 9.0%, it signals a tightening labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE falls below 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates robust economic expansion that drives immediate equity market gains, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized change < 2.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL annualized change is below 2.0% and FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained period of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 600,000 units, it signals strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 600.0 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: In high consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing activity supporting consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 350,000 and INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals an overheating economy that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized change exceeds 3.0%.
